newsitem.title: USA: Cellular Technical sees Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Cellular Technical sees Q4 loss.

text.p: Cellular Technical Services Co Inc said Thursday it expects to report a fourth quarter loss of $2-$3 million, or $0.09-$0.14 a share.
Fourth quarter revenue will be $6-$7 million, Cellular Technical said.
The Seattle company also said it expects to report a loss of $0.29 to $0.34 a share on revenue of about $20 million.

The company, which makes devices for cellular phone companies to detect fraudulent calls, said it will report the losses because it had to record the expenses of installation at new sites, but could not record the full revenue from the contracts until customers are satisfied with the devices' performance.
